items.defectStatement: In verifySafeHtml(), common-prefix and common-suffix lengths are computed independently, allowing them to overlap. The resulting substring end index can precede its start index, throwing StringIndexOutOfBoundsException and aborting verification instead of reporting the illegal HTML.
obligations: Keep substring bounds valid for both strings, including empty strings and overlapping common prefixes and suffixes.
Retain the differing content in the diagnostic when removing shared context.
Continue adding an illegal-HTML diagnostic containing the key, file, and original versus sanitized content.
items.notes: The end index need not be negative to fail; being less than start is sufficient. Independently clamping each substring as suggested can hide the difference (both excerpts become empty for "aaa" versus "aa"). Reporting the complete strings is also a valid fix.
